digest.component_or_area: plan-review criterion T1 web-search capability routing
propositions: Bedrock cutover silently removed server-side web-search capability from blocking criterion T1 by using provider-name prefix matching that failed for bedrock:-qualified Claude models

The web-search decision is gated by a provider-name prefix (`resolved.startswith('anthropic')`) rather than by capability registry membership, violating the epic's zero-exceptions rule against prefix matching
T1's verdict does not record whether web-access capability was attached, making silent capability withdrawals undetectable in signed verdicts
Web-search access must be guaranteed on every provider T1 is routed to, requiring a decision between using Bedrock's native tool support or providing a rebar-side fallback mechanism
The prefix gate must be replaced with a model-profile-derived capability check that takes no provider-name argument and cannot gate on name shape
